detail.longDescription: Hello Mastodon. I'm building Dashmox, a hosting control panel for Linux. It came out of paying more every time I added a website. Per account, per domain, per server. A site costs nothing to run, so this one counts nothing, on any plan including the free one. Nginx, Postfix, Dovecot, PowerDNS, MariaDB on your own box. Panel and agent idle at about 27MB. Commercial, closed source. Free tier live tomorrow, no card, no account. # Introduction # SelfHosted # SysAdmin # WebHosting # Linux
